Accurate

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: sourcery (@sourceryy); megjelent: 2026-11-27T16:45:00+00:00; link: https://x.com/sourceryy/status/2126356627003744717; média: videó, 139 másodperc]
Gavin Baker says SpaceX engineers believe they have solved orbital compute and are actually stressed about Starship reusability

“I think catching the Starship, that was amazing. It was a huge moment for SpaceX.”

“I will just say having spent a lot of time at Starbase, the SpaceX engineers, you know, all of these experts online are very skeptical about orbital compute, and oh the cooling and oh this. And you know, to the SpaceX engineers, they have solved those problems.”

“They’re operating 11,000 satellites today. Starlink V3 actually consumes a significant, we call it maybe 10 to 15% the power of like an orbital compute satellite. It has to be cooled. The compute isn’t as densely packed, but you could do different things in space. They regard the design of the orbital compute satellite, that in their mind, I think they’ve figured that out.”

“What they’re actually stressed about is Starship and reusability, and so catching the upper stage of Starship, that’s a huge step towards making Starlink, direct to cell, orbital compute, all of that a reality.”

prioritas.lead_hu: Elon Musk egy videót osztott meg, amely szerint a SpaceX szakemberei megoldották az űrbéli számítástechnika kihívásait, és most a Starship újrafelhasználhatóságára összpontosítanak.
